text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, while I'm walking through the shopping district with Grass Wonder…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Look at that lively crowd. Is there an event taking place?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see… It's a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Which reminds me… Were you aware, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's said that raffles were originally conceived by the nobility long ago as a way to entertain themselves.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: They would have people draw strips of paper with letters on them and give out prizes like cloth and string.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Aren't you well-informed! How about giving it a go?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, why not? I just happen to have a raffle ticket right here. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you wouldn't mind if I try just once, would you?
choice_data_list: Go get the grand-prize!
Go get the grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll do my best to not let you down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder firmly grasps the lever with both hands and gives the raffle machine a spin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What? R-really?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm overjoyed, truly, but I'm afraid I don't have the time for a vacation at the moment.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you couldn't find the time somehow?
Are you sure you couldn't find the time somehow?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not right now, I'm afraid.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I suppose once things settle down, I could use this as an opportunity to reflect on the path I'll have traveled thus far.
choice_data_list: So in other words, after the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. That way, I'll be able to ascertain my level of satisfaction with the path I've taken.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It would be the perfect time to take a step back and reflect on my progress.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Would you come along with me too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me along?
Are you sure you want me along?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're the one who has been with me every step of the way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Make it a promise, Trainer. It would strengthen my motivation.
choice_data_list: Okay. I'm looking forward to it.
Okay. I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll commit myself to training in preparation for that day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take the hot spring ticket from her with an affirmative nod.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, that looks delicious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Add some grated Japanese radish sauce and I'm sure it'll taste absolutely spectacular.
choice_data_list: Should we buy the sauce on the way home?
Should we buy the sauce on the way home?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I think I would rather buy the radishes and make the sauce myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, could we visit the greengrocer instead?
choice_data_list: Sure.
Sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The idea of making homemade sauce sounds so good that my stomach starts grumbling.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's almost dinnertime, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you like to share it with me?
choice_data_list: Is that okay with you?
Is that okay with you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. ♪ Food is always more enjoyable with company.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take Grass Wonder up on her offer and eat some of the deluxe carrot hamburger steak with her.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Lucky indeed… This certainly is a lot of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, would you like a few of them? ♪
choice_data_list: Are you sure?
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'll also give some to Spe and El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And, since she does so much for me, perhaps Tazuna, too.
choice_data_list: You'll be giving away a lot.
You'll be giving away a lot.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, yes. But hoarding them all to myself would present a risk of overeating.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sharing them is my best method of self-control. ♪
choice_data_list: Brilliant, as always.
Brilliant, as always.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Competition will be fierce for the foreseeable future, so maintaining a perfect condition is key.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, but don't worry. I won't neglect to keep a portion for myself, either! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Impressed by her self-discipline, I return to the academy with Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I set my hopes too high, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then again, this might be just what I needed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I forgot to purchase carrots for tonight's salad at the supermarket earlier today, so the timing couldn't be better.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: True, true. You might've been wishing for a carrot the whole time, and you just didn't know it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, you mean… fate may have had a hand in this, too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In that case, this could very well be my grand-prize.
choice_data_list: That worked out nicely, Grass.
That worked out nicely, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It really did. ♪ Tonight's salad is going to taste that much better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder gains some hop in her step as we head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, this is disappointing. I had hoped for an actual prize of some sort.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Winning raffles must be quite the rare occurrence.
choice_data_list: Have you not played much before?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I haven't. I never had the opportunity before coming to Japan, you see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Before I tried, I thought it would be enough fun just to spin the tumbler, but…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Losing stings a lot more than I expected…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't get so down on yourself. Better luck next time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If you say so…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's shoulders sink as we head back.
